newsitem.title: UK: Vickers eases on worries about tank orders.
newsitem.headline: Vickers eases on worries about tank orders.

text.p: Shares in Vickers Group stumbled after the company -- meeting with analysts this morning after releasing its results for the first half -- said orders for tanks were coming in more slowly than expected, analysts said.
At 1107 GMT, the shares had fallen 10-1/2p to 261p.
A spokeswoman for the UK automotive and defence engineering concern said it expected to see an order from Oman soon and Vickers was confident it should win a contract.
She added that the company does not expect any order to be placed by Saudi Arabia until mid-1997 at soonest.

Earlier, Vickers reported interim pre-tax profits of 31.89 million stg, which was well within analysts' forecasts. It said it expect to make further progress in earnings in the second half of the year nL05175504.
